title: wk-skilllock-audit
desc: Repo-root launcher wk-skilllock-audit.ps1 -- audits recently-touched critical source files for missing harness:skill lock registration in CLAUDE.md, part of the gg Main Workflow step 0.5
steps: WHAT: scans git history for files touched in the last N days (-DaysBack) against critical-source patterns and flags any without a harness:skill lock entry in CLAUDE.md
USAGE: run from repo root as ./wk-skilllock-audit.ps1 -DaysBack 7 (bare wk-skilllock-audit form once on PATH is pace-exempt) -- unprotected files must get a harness:skill block added then re-run to 0
SEE ALSO: skill-lock-audit-and-auto-registration-for-critical-source-files for the full registration procedure

requirements.expect: exit code and list of unprotected files (0 if none)

author: claude
